profile.headline: .Net Developer
profile.summary:
My name is Kevin Nguyen. I am a graduate of Concordia University St. Paul for my Bachelor's of Sciences in Computer Science. I have a passion for software development discovering how new technologies are evolving and interacting with one another. I am currently new to the scene of software development as a recent graduate, but am eager to explore and learn the technologies that run the world.

I have been a .Net developer for about 3 years starting as a Junior Software Developer at Open Access Technologies Inc. and moving onto a Software Engineer I at ProAg. Here I honed my skills in object oriented programming in C# using many versions of .Net Framework starting at 6. I have picked up many front end frameworks and languages ranging from ExtJs, Angular, RazorPages, and React using Javascript, Html, C#, and Typescript. As my career progresses I begin gaining knowledge in cloud platforms with Azure DevOps and AWS deploying many applications there. I hope to continue advancing my career eventually adopting and becoming more experienced in AI.

In my free time I enjoy studying and developing my skills outside of work. I have a passion in developing games within Unity or Unreal Engine using C# or C++ respectively. I focus on optimizing performance to get the best experience for my players. I also enjoy just creating side projects that will help me in my day to day life or at work that are not official company applications.

Thank you for taking the time to look over my profile and I hope I am a fit for your company! I am sure I would be a great addition to any team.

positions.title: Wait Staff
positions.description:
•	Improved cognitive abilities requiring the memorization of menus for the meal and how each meal should be set up.
•	Cleans kitchen and all dinnerware every meal to ensure that everything is clean and stocked for a safe and sanitized environment for guests. 
•	Collaborating with other wait staff to distribute workloads and offer assistance to others to provide quick completion of current tasks.

positions.title: Store Associate
positions.description:
•	Multitasking abilities from working with customers, answering phones, and restocking shelves with new products.
•	Developed a basic understanding of pharmaceutical drugs through communication with the pharmacy for expanded knowledge of store products.
•	Adaptability of assisting customers with their problems or recommending solutions for products or services that Walgreens does not provide.

positions.title: Barista
positions.description: Responsibilities as a barista was making coffee as well as cooperating with customers and coworkers to get the drinks and food ready. That would include asking coworkers for assistance or customers to repeat their order. Other jobs would be including cleaning the store as well as always keeping the front always clean to not contaminate the products.

positions.title: Cashier
positions.description:
Recording orders of individual customers to multiple families requiring the development of listening skills and attention to details for better customized and accurate service.
Developed communication skills to improve interactions with over a hundred customers and to help avoid or resolve issues that may arise.
Collaborated with other team members conveying that orders were correct and minimizing mistakes.
Maintained a clean eating area for customers for an acceptable area to relax and enjoy their meals.
